content:
Pollo AI’da AI Clothes Changer’a ürün fotoğrafını yükleyip model seçerek ve prompt yazarak lifestyle pozda ürünü taşıyan yeni bir görsel üret  
POD tişört mockup’ı için yalnızca baskının tişört üstündeki düz görselini AI Clothes Changer’a yükleyip model seçerek modelsiz mockup’ı “modelin giydiği” görsele çevir  
Tişört mockup’ında arka planı kontrol etmek için prompt’ta arka planı açıkça belirt (ör. cozy bedroom soft light)  
Eski siyah-beyaz, hasarlı fotoğrafları iyileştirmek için önce photo restoration modunda çatlak/ton/yüz netliği düzelt, ardından colorize modunda renklendir

For a POD t-shirt mockup, upload only the flat image of the print on the t-shirt to AI Clothes Changer, select a model, and convert the model-less mockup into an image of the "model wearing" it.  
To control the background in the t-shirt mockup, clearly specify the background in the prompt (e.g., cozy bedroom soft light).  
To restore old black-and-white, damaged photos, first correct cracks/tone/face clarity in photo restoration mode, then colorize in colorize mode.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] first, the cost issue.

Seedance 2.0 in Pollo AI is currently 50% off. It's already one of the cheapest options on the market, and with the discount, it's quite a steal.

An e-commerce seller spending 5-6 dollars per video unknowingly gifts a portion of their salary to the agency every month.

[Thread 2] first use: for the current e-commerce seller.

I had a simple photo of a straw bag. I uploaded it to AI Clothes Changer in Pollo AI, selected a model, and wrote a prompt.

10 seconds later, an image of the model carrying the bag in a lifestyle pose appeared.

Previously, setting up a studio for this would cost $500, a mockup template $30-50, and a real model shoot $1,500.

A few credits in Pollo AI.

[Thread 3] second product: POD t-shirt mockup.

I only had the flat "We the People / Freedom is our Founding" print placed on the t-shirt, without a model.

I uploaded it to the same application. I selected a model. Background: cozy bedroom soft light.

It came out with the model wearing it. The print wasn't distorted, the text wasn't distorted, the eagle figure wasn't distorted.

This feature alone pays for the subscription for anyone selling POD.

[Thread 4] black-and-white / colorized final) + process recording

Now the main issue. Second use: side income opportunity.
I had an old family photo. From the 1950s, black-and-white, with cracks, wrinkles all over the paper, tone imbalance.

I applied two steps in Pollo AI. First, I uploaded it to photo restoration mode, the cracks disappeared, the tone balanced, faces became clear. Then I switched to colorize mode, and the photo turned to color.

The soul of the photo is the same, no damage, and in color for the first time in years.

There are Etsy shops doing this. Thousands.

[Thread 5] When you search "photo restoration" on Etsy:

Prices range from 288 TL to 1,303 TL. The format is the same: send a single image, get the cleaned version back in 2-24 hours.

No stock. No shipping. No returns.

Average sale: $15 production cost: very low

(Seedance 2.0 50% off) Etsy fees + processing: about $2 net profit: around $10-12 per product

For those selling POD on Etsy, wanting to open listings without dressing a model, dropshipping, unable to produce lifestyle images, designers, illustrators, Photoshop-savvy individuals who haven't opened a store but want side income, anyone who can spare 1-2 hours in the evenings.
